verdict.rationale: The evidence documents agent checkout completion, negotiated payment handlers such as com.google.pay, and AP2 payment mandates, but nothing mentions stablecoins or a stablecoin settlement rail. Payment settlement is a fair axis for an agentic commerce product, so this is "none", not "na". Generic payment-authorization material is adjacent and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can settle agent-initiated payments in stablecoins over documented rails
